key_information_units.information: Q4 2024/25 net turnover decreased 13% to EUR 5.18M with a loss of EUR 913K; full year 2024/25 turnover fell 4% to EUR 26.11M with an annual loss of EUR 820K (improved from EUR 2.37M loss in 2023/24), despite global electronic component shortages; the Group controlled expenses within budget and invested in new product development and product enhancements.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report pages 7-8; Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss for Q4 and 12 months pages 14-15; Management Report page 8

key_information_units.information: Q4 regional turnover: North America/Latin America 47% (EUR 2.5M, down 40% YoY); Europe 36% (EUR 1.9M, up 24% YoY); Asia/Africa/Middle East 16% (EUR 846K, doubled YoY).
Quarterly turnover fluctuations are driven by project completion timing, production durations, and material lead times, causing revenue recognition to vary between periods.
The Group ended the period with EUR 4.8M cash balance, EUR 3.9M in customer advances, and an unused EUR 4.95M credit line, indicating strong liquidity positions.

The microwave radio market remained stable with no major changes; the Group monitors global trade risks including potential US tariffs and ongoing Ukraine-related uncertainty, while advancing IoT solution development for diversification.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report pages 8-9 (Market Overview and Guidelines)

key_information_units.information: The Group's products were sold in 75 countries during Q4 2024/25.
